driver_source:
"""Balanced public-call follow-up using unchanged existing JSONX case objects."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from functools import partial
from hashlib import sha256
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import median
import subprocess
import sys

LABELS = ('original', 'first_pass', 'candidate')
PROFILE = {
    '313': ('jsonx.dumpb/string', 'jsonx.dumpb/int', 'jsonx.dumpb/small', 'jsonx.dumps/string', 'jsonx.loads/records', 'jsonx.loads/small'),
    '314': ('jsonx.loads/float', 'jsonx.loads/float/bytes', 'jsonx.loads/string', 'jsonx.loads/string/bytes', 'jsonx.dumpb/wide', 'jsonx.dumpb/int', 'jsonx.dumpb/string'),
}
REGISTRY = {'313': ('unstd.serde.jsonx.dumpb', 'unstd.serde.jsonx.dumps', 'unstd.serde.jsonx.loads'), '314': ('unstd.serde.jsonx.loads', 'unstd.serde.jsonx.dumpb')}
CORE = {'313': 'jsonx.loads · 500 records', '314': 'jsonx.loads · 20 nested records'}


def retained_driver(path):
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('retained_jsonx_driver',path)
    module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def worker(args):
    from bench.core.cases import registry, audit
    from bench.core.timing import measure
    from bench.profiles.serde_profile import _workloads, _same
    from bench.workloads.speed_cases_codecs import _serde_cases
    from unstd.serde import jsonx
    driver=retained_driver(args.driver)
    driver._check_harness(args.harness, (registry,measure,_workloads,_serde_cases))
    metadata=driver._provenance(args.source,jsonx)
    environment=driver._environment()
    harness=driver._harness_hashes(args.harness)
    profiles={case.name:case for case in _workloads()}
    public={case.name:case for case in _serde_cases()}
    core=next(case for case in registry(('serde',)) if case.name==CORE[args.abi])
    assert core.available
    assert not audit([core])
    payload=core.payload()
    # Each callable is the existing Workload.call / Case.run / core partial.
    # Checkers and fixture construction stay outside the timer.
    calls={}
    checks={}
    for name in PROFILE[args.abi]:
        case=profiles[name]
        calls['profile:'+name]=case.call
        checks['profile:'+name]=partial(_same,expected=case.expected)
    for name in REGISTRY[args.abi]:
        case=public[name]
        calls['registry:'+name]=case.run
        def check(value,case=case):
            case.check(value)
            return True
        checks['registry:'+name]=check
    calls['core:'+core.name]=partial(core.accel,payload)
    calls['stdlib:'+core.name]=partial(core.base,payload)
    expected=core.base(payload)
    checks['core:'+core.name]=partial(_same,expected=expected)
    checks['stdlib:'+core.name]=partial(_same,expected=expected)
    for name,call in calls.items():
        assert checks[name](call()),name
    names=list(calls)
    offset=(args.repetition-1)%len(names)
    order=names[offset:]+names[:offset]
    measurements={name:asdict(measure(calls[name],rounds=args.rounds)) for name in order}
    for name,call in calls.items():
        assert checks[name](call()),name
    assert not audit([core])
    assert metadata==driver._provenance(args.source,jsonx)
    assert harness==driver._harness_hashes(args.harness)
    assert environment==driver._environment()
    return {'provenance':metadata,'environment':environment,'harness_sha256':harness,'case_order':order,'measurements':measurements}


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--abi',choices=PROFILE,required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--original',type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--first-pass',type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--candidate',type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--harness',type=Path,required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--driver',type=Path,required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--rounds',type=int,default=7)
    parser.add_argument('--repetitions',type=int,default=6)
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--worker',action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--source',type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--repetition',type=int)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    args.harness=args.harness.resolve();args.driver=args.driver.resolve()
    assert args.rounds==7 and args.repetitions==6
    if args.worker:
        args.source=args.source.resolve()
        print(json.dumps(worker(args)))
        return
    sources=(('original',args.original.resolve()),('first_pass',args.first_pass.resolve()),('candidate',args.candidate.resolve()))
    script=Path(__file__).resolve()
    report={'purpose':'Independent balanced follow-up of unchanged existing public Python fixtures; primary matrix remains unchanged','abi':args.abi,'driver_source':script.read_text(),'driver_sha256':sha256(script.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'command':[sys.executable,*sys.argv],'rounds':args.rounds,'repetitions':args.repetitions,'source_order':'Cyclically rotate original/first_pass/candidate; six repetitions balance each source position twice','case_order':'Rotate the same existing callables across repetition; order is identical for each source in that repetition','estimator':'Median across six source repetitions of the existing minimum calibrated wall-clock batch means; thread CPU samples are separate diagnostics','runs':[]}
    for repetition in range(1,args.repetitions+1):
        offset=(repetition-1)%len(sources)
        for label,source in sources[offset:]+sources[:offset]:
            command=[sys.executable,str(script),'--worker','--abi',args.abi,'--source',str(source),'--harness',str(args.harness),'--driver',str(args.driver),'--rounds',str(args.rounds),'--repetition',str(repetition)]
            completed=subprocess.run(command,cwd=args.harness,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=os.pathsep.join((str(source),str(args.harness))),PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'),capture_output=True,text=True,check=False)
            if completed.returncode:
                report['failure']={'command':command,'stdout':completed.stdout,'stderr':completed.stderr,'returncode':completed.returncode};args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');raise RuntimeError(report['failure'])
            result=json.loads(completed.stdout)
            report['runs'].append({'label':label,'repetition':repetition,'worker_command':command,**result})
            args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
            print(f'{args.abi}: {label} repetition {repetition}',file=sys.stderr,flush=True)
    runs=report['runs'];first=runs[0]
    for run in runs:
        assert run['environment']==first['environment']
        assert run['harness_sha256']==first['harness_sha256']
        prior=next(row for row in runs if row['label']==run['label'])
        assert run['provenance']==prior['provenance']
    comparisons={}
    for name in sorted(first['measurements']):
        wall={label:median(run['measurements'][name]['per_op_ns'] for run in runs if run['label']==label) for label in LABELS}
        cpu={label:median(min(value for value in run['measurements'][name]['cpu_samples_ns'] if value is not None) for run in runs if run['label']==label) for label in LABELS}
        samples={label:[run['measurements'][name]['per_op_ns'] for run in runs if run['label']==label] for label in LABELS}
        comparisons[name]={'wall_ns':wall,'thread_cpu_min_ns_diagnostic':cpu,'per_repetition_wall_ns':samples,'final_over_original_speedup':wall['original']/wall['candidate'],'final_over_first_pass_speedup':wall['first_pass']/wall['candidate'],'maximum_spread':max(run['measurements'][name]['spread'] for run in runs)}
    report['comparisons']=comparisons;report['complete']=True
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')


if __name__=='__main__':main()
source_order: Cyclically rotate original/first_pass/candidate; six repetitions balance each source position twice
case_order: Rotate the same existing callables across repetition; order is identical for each source in that repetition
estimator: Median across six source repetitions of the existing minimum calibrated wall-clock batch means; thread CPU samples are separate diagnostics
